title: Accessible Modal Dialog with Portal, Focus Trap & Escape Key Handler
whatThisCodeCovers: Renders an accessible modal dialog outside parent DOM overflow using createPortal, managing body scroll locking, keyboard focus trapping, and Esc key dismissal.
breakdown: createPortal renders the dialog as a direct child of document.body, escaping parent overflow:hidden clipping.
Locks document.body.style.overflow to prevent background wheel scrolling while the modal is open.
Listens to keydown on window to support standard accessible Escape key dismissal.
e.stopPropagation() on modal-dialog prevents child clicks from bubbling to the backdrop close handler.
Cleans up event listeners and restores body overflow when unmounted or closed.
expectedOutput: Modal opens rendered directly into document.body with background scroll locked and focus trapped.

title: Custom Imperative Media Player Controller with useImperativeHandle
whatThisCodeCovers: Encapsulates a native HTML5 video element inside a child component, exposing a restricted, safe imperative control API (play, pause, seek) to parent components.
breakdown: forwardRef allows the parent MediaDashboard to pass playerRef to the child VideoPlayer.
useImperativeHandle intercepts the ref and exposes only play, pause, restart, and getCurrentTime.
The parent cannot access raw video DOM attributes or tamper with internal video styling.
Maintains internal playback status state synchronized with HTML5 video event callbacks.
expectedOutput: VideoPlayer controlled cleanly via playerRef.current.play() without exposing raw DOM node.

title: Precise DOM Element Geometry Measurement with useLayoutEffect
whatThisCodeCovers: Measures real DOM element dimensions synchronously before browser paint using useLayoutEffect to position an anchored popup tooltip without visual layout flicker.
breakdown: useLayoutEffect fires synchronously immediately after React mutates the DOM, but before the browser paints.
Measures exact pixel height and width of the tooltip via getBoundingClientRect().
Calculating position in useLayoutEffect guarantees the user never sees the tooltip flash at (0,0) before jumping.
Includes viewport bounds checking to prevent tooltips from clipping off-screen.
expectedOutput: Tooltip appears immediately at the exact computed anchor coordinates with zero visual flicker.

title: Dynamic Form Resetting using the Component Key Prop
whatThisCodeCovers: Resets complex nested form component state cleanly by changing its key prop, unmounting the old instance and mounting a fresh instance without manual reset effects.
breakdown: When activeCustomerId switches from 101 to 102, React detects a new key on CustomerEditor.
The previous Fiber instance is destroyed, unmounting all old internal state (email, notes, dirty).
A brand new component instance is mounted with fresh initial state corresponding to customer 102.
Completely eliminates buggy useEffect syncing code where developers forget to clear drafts.
expectedOutput: Switching tabs mounts clean form state instantly with 0 cross-contamination between customers.

title: Synthetic Event Delegation with Capture Phase Interception
whatThisCodeCovers: Intercepts user interaction events during the capture phase using onClickCapture to log audit telemetry or enforce global permissions before child handlers execute.
breakdown: onClickCapture executes during the descending capture phase, prior to child element bubble listeners.
e.target.closest('[data-permission="write"]') inspects whether the target element requires write permissions.
Calling e.stopPropagation() inside the capture handler prevents the event from reaching the child's onClick handler.
Provides centralized permission assertion across all nested interactive elements.
expectedOutput: Viewer clicks on write-protected buttons are intercepted and blocked before executing action.

title: Auto-Resizing Textarea with DOM Refs and ScrollHeight
whatThisCodeCovers: Builds a smooth auto-expanding textarea component that dynamically grows and shrinks with user typing by measuring scrollHeight via a DOM ref.
breakdown: Attaches textareaRef to inspect the native DOM textarea node.
Resets textarea.style.height = 'auto' before measuring, allowing the field to shrink when text is deleted.
Calculates height matching textarea.scrollHeight bounded by maxRows.
Enables vertical scrollbar only if the content exceeds the maximum configured row height.
expectedOutput: Textarea height expands smoothly as text wraps and contracts cleanly on backspace.

title: Copy to Clipboard Feedback Button with Timer Ref Cleanup
whatThisCodeCovers: Implements a copy-to-clipboard button with visual confirmation feedback, using a timer ref to clean up timeouts if the component unmounts mid-timer.
breakdown: Uses modern browser navigator.clipboard.writeText asynchronous API.
timerRef stores the active setTimeout handle across component re-renders.
Clears pending timer if user clicks multiple times in rapid succession.
useEffect cleanup guarantees clearTimeout fires on unmount, eliminating 'Can't perform state update on unmounted component' memory leaks.
expectedOutput: Button copies text, changes label to '✓ Copied!', and safely reverts after 2000ms.

title: Drag and Drop File Upload Area with Drag Event Handlers
whatThisCodeCovers: Creates an interactive drag-and-drop file upload dropzone handling dragenter, dragleave, and drop events while managing file validation.
breakdown: e.preventDefault() and e.stopPropagation() on onDragOver are mandatory to allow drop events in browsers.
dragCounter ref resolves the classic HTML5 drag bug where hovering over child elements triggers premature dragleave.
Filters uploaded files against the allowed MIME type array in e.dataTransfer.files.
Toggles visual styling smoothly via isDragging state.
expectedOutput: Dropzone highlights when dragging files over container and extracts valid dropped files.

title: Infinite Scroll Trigger using Intersection Observer API
whatThisCodeCovers: Builds a high-performance infinite scroll sentinel trigger using the browser IntersectionObserver API attached via a callback ref.
breakdown: Uses a callback ref on the sentinel element to ensure the observer connects only when the DOM node exists.
rootMargin: '200px' starts loading the next page 200 pixels before the user reaches the bottom, creating a seamless feed.
Disconnects previous observer instance before creating a new one to prevent memory leaks.
Checks isLoading to prevent duplicate simultaneous fetch requests.
expectedOutput: List automatically triggers onLoadMore when scrolling within 200px of sentinel element.

title: Outside Click Dismissal Container for Dropdown Menus
whatThisCodeCovers: Detects and handles mouse clicks occurring outside a target container element, dismissing dropdowns and flyout menus automatically.
breakdown: containerRef wraps the trigger button and the popup menu together.
containerRef.current.contains(event.target) checks if the clicked target belongs to the component tree.
If contains() returns false, the user clicked outside; setIsOpen(false) dismisses the menu.
Attaches listener to document on 'mousedown' and cleanly removes on unmount or close.
expectedOutput: Dropdown closes automatically whenever user clicks anywhere outside the container.

title: Multi-Step Wizard with Preserved Unmounted Step Data
whatThisCodeCovers: Constructs a multi-step checkout wizard that preserves data entered across unmounted steps while validating inputs before advancing.
breakdown: State (formData) is hoisted to the wizard parent, keeping input values alive when steps unmount.
Current step is toggled via currentStep number state.
Back buttons let users revisit previous steps with their typed values perfectly intact.
Next buttons are disabled until required step fields satisfy validation criteria.
expectedOutput: Users navigate back and forth through steps with zero loss of previously entered form data.

title: useDebounce Value Hook for High-Performance Search Input Filtering
whatThisCodeCovers: Builds a production-grade useDebounce hook that delays updating a debounced value until typing pauses for a configured delay in milliseconds.
breakdown: useDebounce maintains internal debouncedValue state updated via setTimeout.
Returning clearTimeout(timer) in the effect cleanup cancels pending timers whenever value changes.
Reduces 10 keystrokes down to a single network search request.
Provides responsive local typing while protecting backend APIs from request floods.
expectedOutput: debouncedQuery updates only after 400ms of inactivity, triggering a single search query.

title: useThrottle Callback Hook for Scroll & Resize Event Throttling
whatThisCodeCovers: Throttles high-frequency function executions to run at most once per time interval, preserving browser framerate during scroll and window resize events.
breakdown: lastRunRef stores the timestamp of the last executed call across renders without triggering re-renders.
If more than limit ms have elapsed, callback executes immediately.
Guarantees that high-frequency 60 FPS scroll events execute at most 10 times per second.
Includes a trailing edge timeout to guarantee the final scroll position is recorded.
expectedOutput: Scroll callback fires at most once every 100ms, preserving 60 FPS UI responsiveness.

title: useLocalStorage with Multi-Tab Storage Event Synchronization
whatThisCodeCovers: Persists state to browser localStorage with SSR safety, error handling for quota limits, and cross-tab synchronization using the native storage event.
breakdown: Initializes state via lazy initializer with typeof window checks for Next.js / SSR compatibility.
Supports functional state updates: setValue(prev => prev + 1).
Listens to window.addEventListener('storage', ...) to synchronize state across multiple open tabs.
Wraps all reads and writes in try/catch to gracefully handle disabled cookies or quota limits.
expectedOutput: Changes made in Tab A update localStorage and reflect instantaneously in Tab B without reload.

title: useMediaQuery Hook for Responsive JavaScript Design Breakpoints
whatThisCodeCovers: Tracks CSS media query matches in JavaScript using window.matchMedia and the change event, enabling dynamic conditional rendering based on viewport size.
breakdown: Uses modern window.matchMedia(query) and MediaQueryList 'change' event listener.
Returns a reactive boolean updating automatically when the user resizes browser windows.
Supports arbitrary media queries: screen widths, orientation, and prefers-color-scheme dark mode.
Cleans up listeners on unmount or query change.
expectedOutput: isMobile switches between true and false as viewport passes the 768px threshold.

title: useFetch with AbortController, Retry Counter & Cache Map
whatThisCodeCovers: A complete data-fetching hook supporting in-memory response caching, automatic request abortion on unmount, and a manual refetch retry mechanism.
breakdown: Module-level Map provides instant cache hits across multiple components requesting identical URLs.
AbortController automatically aborts in-flight network requests when components unmount.
Filters out AbortError so cancellation isn't treated as an application error.
Exposes refetch() method that invalidates cache and triggers re-execution.
expectedOutput: Fetches data asynchronously, caches result, and cancels stale requests on unmount.

title: usePrevious Hook Using Ref Stash for Value Delta Comparisons
whatThisCodeCovers: Implements the classic usePrevious hook that tracks the value of a prop or state variable from the immediately preceding render pass.
breakdown: ref.current stores the value from the preceding render.
The component returns ref.current during render (which holds the old value).
useEffect runs AFTER paint, updating ref.current to the new value ready for the subsequent render.
Allows tracking deltas, previous routes, or previous focus elements without triggering extra re-renders.
expectedOutput: Displays current price alongside calculated delta from the previous render value.

title: useInterval Hook with Dynamic Delay and Stable Callback Execution
whatThisCodeCovers: Dan Abramov's canonical useInterval declarative hook that prevents stale closure bugs and supports dynamic delay updates or pausing.
breakdown: savedCallback ref mirrors the latest callback reference on every render.
The timer effect depends only on [delay], meaning changes to state inside callback do NOT reset the timer interval.
Passing delay = null cleanly pauses the timer by clearing the interval.
Completely eliminates the classic React setInterval stale closure bug.
expectedOutput: Timer increments accurately and allows changing speed dynamically without losing interval alignment.

title: useOnClickOutside Hook for Reusable Modal & Menu Dismissal
whatThisCodeCovers: Extracts outside click detection into a reusable hook that attaches mouse and touch listeners to dismiss flyout panels and popovers.
breakdown: Listens to both 'mousedown' and 'touchstart' to ensure compatibility with mobile devices.
Checks ref.current.contains(event.target) to confirm the click was outside.
Passes event to handler callback, allowing caller to inspect target or prevent default.
Encapsulates 20 lines of repetitive DOM event boilerplate into a 1-line hook call.
expectedOutput: Invokes onClose callback whenever user clicks or taps outside the referenced popover.

title: useEventListener Hook with Automatic Window and Document Cleanup
whatThisCodeCovers: A type-safe useEventListener hook supporting window, document, or specific element targets with automatic listener teardown.
breakdown: savedHandler ref ensures changing handler functions does not cause remove/re-add churn of event listeners.
Accepts window, document, or React ref object as the target element.
Supports passive event listener configuration options for smooth scrolling.
Simplifies global keyboard shortcut management.
expectedOutput: Cmd+K or Ctrl+K triggers quick search toggle globally with zero memory leaks.

title: useNetworkStatus Hook with Online and Offline Browser Listeners
whatThisCodeCovers: Tracks real-time device internet connectivity and warns users with an offline banner when network drops.
breakdown: Initializes with navigator.onLine with safe SSR check.
Subscribes to native window 'online' and 'offline' browser events.
Returns a boolean flag that UI components can use for reconnection banners or disabling submit buttons.
Cleans up listeners automatically on component unmount.
expectedOutput: Offline banner appears immediately when internet drops and vanishes when restored.

title: useWhyDidYouUpdate Diagnostic Hook for Component Render Profiling
whatThisCodeCovers: A diagnostic hook that compares previous and current props, logging the exact keys and reference changes that caused a component to re-render in the console.
breakdown: previousProps ref stores the props object from the previous render.
Compares previousProps.current and current props key by key using reference inequality (!==).
Logs formatted console.table showing exactly which prop changed from what reference to what reference.
Instantly identifies unstable callbacks or inline object props breaking React.memo.
expectedOutput: Console table prints: [WhyDidYouUpdate] DataGrid: onFilter changed from Function to Function.

title: Undo / Redo History State Machine with useReducer
whatThisCodeCovers: Implements full time-travel undo and redo history tracking around an arbitrary state value using a pure reducer maintaining past, present, and future stacks.
breakdown: past array holds previous snapshots; future array holds undone snapshots for redo.
Dispatching 'SET' clears future stack, establishing a new timeline branch.
canUndo and canRedo booleans easily control button disabled states.
Provides reliable undo/redo for canvas editors, text areas, or complex configuration builders.
expectedOutput: Users can modify text, click Undo to revert to previous states, and click Redo to restore.

title: Normalized Entity Store with Normalized Insert, Update & Delete Actions
whatThisCodeCovers: Maintains a relational, normalized entity store (byId and allIds) inside useReducer, achieving O(1) lookups and updates without deep nested object cloning.
breakdown: byId dictionary stores entities keyed by their unique ID, enabling O(1) lookups and updates.
allIds array maintains the explicit display order of entities.
Deleting an entity uses object destructuring (const { [id]: deleted, ...remainingById } = state.byId).
Eliminates slow array.map and array.find traversals across large datasets.
expectedOutput: Entities are inserted, updated, and deleted with clean O(1) dictionary operations.

title: Async Multi-Step Wizard State Machine with Guaranteed Finite States
whatThisCodeCovers: Models an asynchronous multi-step onboarding wizard as a Finite State Machine (FSM) inside useReducer to prevent impossible loading/error overlap states.
breakdown: status string acts as the FSM discriminator, completely eliminating impossible combinations like isProcessing && isSuccess.
Actions can only trigger valid transitions defined for the active state.
If payment fails, state returns to STEP_2_PAYMENT with the specific error populated.
Keeps complex multi-step async UI completely deterministic.
expectedOutput: Wizard steps progress strictly through valid states (STEP_1 -> STEP_2 -> PROCESSING -> SUCCESS).

title: Shopping Cart Reducer with Discounts, Taxes & Quantity Caps
whatThisCodeCovers: A comprehensive e-commerce shopping cart reducer managing item additions, removals, stock quantity limits, discount promo codes, and sales tax calculation.
breakdown: Manages additions, quantity increments/decrements, and removals in an immutable array.
Caps quantities to item.maxStock to prevent ordering out-of-stock inventory.
Computes subtotal, discount, and tax during render rather than storing redundant derived numbers in state.
Handles coupon validation cleanly via pure action dispatch.
expectedOutput: Cart recalculates subtotal, discounts, and tax accurately with quantity caps enforced.

title: Context-Reducer Architecture with Context Splitting
whatThisCodeCovers: Combines useReducer with React Context splitting (StateContext and DispatchContext) to provide scalable global state with zero unnecessary consumer re-renders.
breakdown: TasksContext holds the dynamic tasks array; TasksDispatchContext holds the stable dispatch function.
Components that only dispatch actions (like AddTaskInput) consume TasksDispatchContext.
When tasks update, components consuming only dispatch skip re-rendering entirely (0ms render overhead).
The gold standard architecture for mid-sized React state management without third-party libraries.
expectedOutput: Dispatchers stay reference-stable; state consumers re-render only when data array mutates.

title: Multi-Filter Data Table State with Sorting, Pagination & Reset
whatThisCodeCovers: Coordinates complex tabular filtering, multi-column sort directions, page size, and pagination offset using a unified table state reducer.
breakdown: Centralizes 6 interconnected table query parameters into a single reducer.
Changing search or filters automatically resets page back to 1, preventing empty page bugs.
Toggling column sort swaps asc and desc or switches target column cleanly.
RESET_ALL restores defaults in a single atomic action.
expectedOutput: Table parameters stay synchronized; updating search resets pagination to page 1.

title: Complex Dynamic Nested Form Field Array Manager
whatThisCodeCovers: Manages a dynamic list of nested form inputs (e.g. multiple phone numbers or team members) with add, remove, and field update capabilities.
breakdown: Manages dynamic collection rows using immutable array operations.
Each member item has a stable unique ID (Date.now()) ensuring input focus is preserved on deletions.
Disallows removing the last remaining row (disabled={form.members.length === 1}).
Field updates update only the matching row ID via array.map.
expectedOutput: Users dynamically add and remove member rows without affecting existing input values.

title: Notification Toast Queue Dispatcher with Auto-Dismiss Timers
whatThisCodeCovers: A centralized notification toast system maintaining a queue of active alerts with automatic timer dismissals and manual dismiss actions.
breakdown: toasts array holds current visible banners.
showToast generates unique ID and pushes to reducer.
setTimeout automatically enqueues REMOVE_TOAST after configured milliseconds.
Manual cross button allows immediate user dismissal before timer expires.
expectedOutput: Toast notifications appear in a fixed floating container and disappear automatically after 3s.

title: Infinite Undo Canvas State with Action Compression
whatThisCodeCovers: Optimizes drawing canvas history by compressing continuous mouse drag events into single discrete undo/redo steps.
breakdown: Instead of pushing 500 mousemove events into history, APPEND_POINT mutates only the temporary currentStroke.
START_STROKE preserves the previous snapshot once.
END_STROKE commits the entire line path as a single atomic drawing stroke.
Undo rolls back the entire pencil stroke at once rather than undoing 1 pixel per click.
expectedOutput: Drawing on canvas records continuous strokes while single Undo click removes the full stroke.

title: Audio Playlist State Machine with Play, Pause, Next & Shuffle
whatThisCodeCovers: A media playlist state machine orchestrating track indexing, playback state, loop modes, and Fisher-Yates array shuffling.
breakdown: Uses modulo arithmetic ((currentIndex + 1) % length) to wrap cleanly from the last track to the first.
PREV_TRACK safely handles negative offsets using (currentIndex - 1 + length) % length.
SHUFFLE executes immutable Fisher-Yates randomization on the tracks array.
Centralizes audio player controls into predictable, testable action transitions.
expectedOutput: Player cycles through tracks seamlessly, looping back to start and supporting shuffle mode.

title: Non-Blocking Search Filter with useTransition and Pending Indicator
whatThisCodeCovers: Uses React 18 useTransition to keep a search input responsive at 60 FPS while filtering a massive 10,000-item array in the background, displaying an inline loading spinner.
breakdown: setSearchTerm updates immediately, ensuring zero typing lag or stutter on the input element.
startTransition tells React that filtering 10,000 items is interruptible background work.
If the user types a new character before the filter finishes, React discards stale work and restarts with the new query.
isPending provides clean visual feedback without replacing the list with a blank screen.
expectedOutput: Typing is completely instantaneous and smooth; background list updates with subtle pending indicator.

title: Fast Typing in Heavy Data Grids with useDeferredValue
whatThisCodeCovers: Defers slow re-renders of a child data grid using useDeferredValue when receiving values via props without direct setter access.
breakdown: query updates synchronously on every keystroke, keeping the input completely responsive.
deferredQuery retains the previous value on the urgent pass and catches up in a background transition pass.
HeavyDataGrid is wrapped in React.memo, allowing it to skip rendering on the urgent pass.
Comparing query !== deferredQuery exposes isStale for visual feedback.
expectedOutput: User types at high speed without keystroke latency; heavy table catches up smoothly in background.

title: React 19 Form Submission Action with useActionState and Server Validation
whatThisCodeCovers: A modern React 19 form using useActionState with an asynchronous action function, handling form validation errors and pending submit states.
breakdown: useActionState binds the async createPostAction function to the form.
formAction is passed directly to <form action={formAction}>.
isPending automatically tracks when the async action is awaiting network promises.
state holds validation errors or success messages returned by the action function.
expectedOutput: Form submits via React 19 Action; button disables automatically during in-flight network request.

title: Real-Time Chat Message Feed with useOptimistic Instant Echo
whatThisCodeCovers: Demonstrates speculative UI rendering with React 19's useOptimistic hook, displaying sent chat messages instantly and rolling back on network failure.
breakdown: useOptimistic creates a speculative message branch attached to the current messages prop.
setOptimisticMessages(text) renders the new message in the DOM in <1ms before network request starts.
Once onSendMessage resolves or rejects, React drops the optimistic branch.
If the action fails and throws, the optimistic message automatically vanishes without writing manual rollback logic.
expectedOutput: Chat message appears immediately on Send click with a subtle hourglass icon until server confirms.

title: Loading State Extraction inside Child Buttons with useFormStatus
whatThisCodeCovers: Uses React DOM's useFormStatus hook to create a reusable submit button that reads parent form pending state without any prop drilling.
breakdown: useFormStatus is imported from 'react-dom'.
Must be placed in a component rendered inside a <form> tag.
Extracts pending boolean directly from React's internal form context.
Eliminates the need for parent forms to pass isSubmitting or loading props down to buttons.
expectedOutput: SubmitButton automatically disables and shows spinner whenever parent form action is running.

title: Unrolling Dynamic Data Promises in Render with the use() Hook
whatThisCodeCovers: Unwraps asynchronous data promises directly inside component render functions using the React 19 use() hook combined with Suspense.
breakdown: The use(promise) hook unrolls promises without requiring useEffect or useState.
If the promise is pending, the component suspends and the nearest Suspense fallback renders.
If the promise rejects, the nearest ErrorBoundary catches the error.
Unlike standard hooks, use() can be called inside loops and conditional if blocks.
expectedOutput: Component suspends while promise is in flight and renders data synchronously once resolved.

title: Dynamic Document Head Meta and Canonical Tag Injection in React 19
whatThisCodeCovers: Natively hoists document title, meta description, and canonical link tags to document head in React 19 without third-party libraries.
breakdown: React 19 intercepts <title>, <meta>, and <link> elements during rendering.
Automatically hoists them out of the body and inserts them into document <head>.
Handles deduplication and overrides previous meta tags natively.
Completely replaces external legacy libraries like react-helmet.
expectedOutput: Browser tab displays article title and document <head> contains correct OpenGraph meta tags.

title: Asset Preloading with preload and preinit in react-dom
whatThisCodeCovers: Uses React 19's native asset preloading functions (preload, preinit, prefetchDNS) to optimize web font, stylesheet, and external script loading.
breakdown: preload tells the browser to download a high-priority asset (like fonts or hero images) early.
preinit loads and applies styles or scripts immediately in document <head>.
prefetchDNS initiates early DNS handshakes for third-party asset domains.
Dramatically reduces FOIT (Flash of Invisible Text) and improves Core Web Vitals LCP score.
expectedOutput: Browser immediately requests critical fonts and styles before component HTML finishes rendering.

title: Ref-as-a-Prop Direct Forwarding in React 19 (Zero forwardRef)
whatThisCodeCovers: Demonstrates the React 19 simplification where ref is passed directly as a standard prop into function component arguments without forwardRef.
breakdown: In React 19, ref is no longer an excluded reserved keyword intercepted by compiler gymnastics.
Function components receive ref directly in their props argument.
Eliminates forwardRef wrapper ceremony and simplifies TypeScript prop types.
Directly backward-compatible with older ref handling.
expectedOutput: Parent component focuses child input directly through ref prop without forwardRef wrapper.

title: Synchronous Native DOM Flush with flushSync
whatThisCodeCovers: Forces React to flush pending state updates synchronously to the DOM using flushSync to measure elements or scroll immediately after an update.
breakdown: Normal setState schedules an update; reading DOM immediately afterward sees outdated DOM height.
flushSync forces React to reconcile and commit the DOM mutation synchronously.
Immediately following flushSync, listRef.current.scrollHeight includes the newly added message.
Enables instant scrolling to bottom without requiring a delayed useEffect tick.
expectedOutput: Chat pane adds message and scrolls instantly to the bottom in the exact same event tick.

title: Windowed Virtual List with react-window for 100,000 Records
whatThisCodeCovers: Renders 100,000 items at 60 FPS by rendering only the visible viewport rows using react-window virtualization.
breakdown: FixedSizeList calculates the visible scroll range based on container height (450px) and itemSize (40px).
Only ~15 physical <div> nodes are mounted in the browser DOM at any time.
The style prop passes absolute positioning (top: 400px), recycling DOM nodes as user scrolls.
overscanCount={5} pre-renders a small buffer above and below to eliminate whitespace flash on fast flick scrolling.
expectedOutput: Users scroll through 100,000 records with buttery-smooth 60 FPS performance and <5MB DOM memory.

title: Route-Based Code Splitting with React.lazy and Error Boundary Fallback
whatThisCodeCovers: Splits large administrative routes into on-demand asynchronous chunks using React.lazy, Suspense, and a dedicated Error Boundary to catch network chunk loading failures.
breakdown: lazy(() => import(...)) instructs bundlers to emit separate JavaScript chunk files.
Browser downloads AnalyticsDashboard chunk ONLY when the user clicks the Analytics route link.
ChunkErrorBoundary catches network dropouts or 404s when a new deployment invalidates older chunk hashes.
Suspense displays a skeleton screen while the chunk downloads over the network.
expectedOutput: Initial bundle excludes admin code; navigating to /analytics downloads chunk on demand.

title: Fine-Grained React.memo with Custom Equality Comparator
whatThisCodeCovers: Wraps a complex chart widget in React.memo with a custom comparator function, ignoring irrelevant parent prop changes and re-rendering only when core telemetry IDs change.
breakdown: Second argument to React.memo is areChartPropsEqual(prevProps, nextProps).
Note the inverse logic: returning true tells React to SKIP re-rendering; returning false forces re-rendering.
Ignores newly created inline callbacks or unstable parent container props.
Prevents heavy SVG canvas recalculations when unrelated parent state updates.
expectedOutput: HeavyChart skips re-rendering when parent renders unless chartId, dataVersion, or theme changes.

title: Web Worker Offloading for Client-Side CSV / Excel Parsing
whatThisCodeCovers: Offloads the parsing of massive 50MB CSV files to a Web Worker background thread, keeping the React UI animated and responsive without dropped frames.
breakdown: Instantiates a dedicated Web Worker running on an independent background operating system thread.
Offloads heavy CSV parsing out of JavaScript's single main thread.
The React UI maintains smooth CSS animations and button responsiveness even while parsing 500,000 lines.
Cleans up and terminates the worker on unmount via worker.terminate().
expectedOutput: 50MB CSV parses in background; React UI remains completely fluid with 0 frame drops.

title: Context Provider Value Stabilization with useMemo
whatThisCodeCovers: Stops widespread consumer re-renders by memoizing the Context Provider's value object and callbacks using useMemo and useCallback.
breakdown: Without useMemo, <Provider value={{ user, updateUserRole }}> instantiates a new object literal on every render.
Consumers of UserContext compare previous value to next value using Object.is.
useMemo guarantees that if user hasn't changed, the contextValue object keeps the identical memory address.
When sibling state (like theme) updates, UserContext consumers skip re-rendering entirely.
expectedOutput: Context consumers only re-render when user actually changes, not when parent provider re-renders.

title: Re-render Isolation via Component Composition (Passing Subtree as Children)
whatThisCodeCovers: Eliminates unnecessary re-renders of a heavy component tree without using React.memo, simply by lifting the heavy component and passing it as children into a stateful container.
breakdown: ScrollHighlightContainer re-renders on every scroll event as scrollY state changes.
However, HeavyComplexTree is created in PageLayout's render scope and passed in as props.children.
Because PageLayout did not re-render, children has the identical element object reference.
React skips reconciling the children subtree entirely with 0 lines of useMemo or React.memo.
expectedOutput: Container updates scroll indicator at 60 FPS while heavy child component tree never re-renders.

title: Responsive Image Component with AVIF/WebP srcset & Blur Placeholder
whatThisCodeCovers: A high-performance responsive image component that prevents layout shift (CLS), uses modern WebP/AVIF picture sources, and displays a smooth blur placeholder transition.
breakdown: style.aspectRatio reserves exact pixel dimensions prior to image download, eliminating Cumulative Layout Shift.
<picture> serves AVIF to modern browsers and falls back to WebP and JPG.
loading='lazy' defers offscreen images; decoding='async' prevents main-thread image decoding stalls.
Fades smoothly from blur placeholder to high-resolution image on load.
expectedOutput: Images load with zero layout shift, serving AVIF to modern devices with a smooth blur fade-in.

title: Programmatic Render Profiling with the <Profiler> Component
whatThisCodeCovers: Instruments real user performance monitoring in code using the React Profiler component, logging slow component renders exceeding 16ms to APM telemetry.
breakdown: Profiler measures the render performance of its descendants in milliseconds.
actualDuration tells you how long the actual render took (after React.memo bailing).
baseDuration estimates how long it would take without any memoization.
Enables continuous real-user monitoring (RUM) in staging and production canaries.
expectedOutput: Logs warning to APM whenever the monitored subtree takes longer than 16.6ms to commit.

title: Resilient Error Boundary with Sentry Telemetry and User Retry Reset
whatThisCodeCovers: A production-grade class Error Boundary that catches runtime render exceptions, reports componentStack traces to monitoring, and provides a working reset mechanism.
breakdown: getDerivedStateFromError updates state to render the fallback UI immediately in the render pass.
componentDidCatch sends the full componentStack to error reporting services.
handleReset clears error state and invokes onReset, allowing children to re-mount with clean state.
Prevents a single widget crash from bringing down the entire application.
expectedOutput: Widget crashes render a localized fallback card with a working 'Try Again' recovery button.

title: Headless Accessible Dropdown using the Compound Component Pattern
whatThisCodeCovers: Builds a flexible, accessible dropdown menu using compound components sharing an internal context with arrow key navigation and ARIA attributes.
breakdown: Dropdown wraps state and exposes Dropdown.Trigger, Dropdown.Menu, and Dropdown.Item.
Coordinates keyboard navigation: ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, and Escape seamlessly across components.
Pre-wires ARIA roles (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, role='listbox', role='option').
Consumers assemble dropdowns naturally without passing rigid configuration objects.
expectedOutput: Dropdown opens, highlights active item via arrow keys, and selects item via Enter or click.
